description: Source code for a minimal vector-backed retrieval augmented generation (RAG) agent demonstrating document ingestion and question answering using embeddings, similarity search, and LLM synthesis.

classes.name: IngestResult
classes.description: Schema for document ingestion output, including document ID and chunk count.

classes.name: SourceChunk
classes.description: Schema for metadata of a text chunk used as a source in responses.

classes.name: QAResponse
classes.description: Schema for the answer and sources returned by the question-answering reasoner.

classes.name: _AnswerOnly
classes.description: Internal schema for prompting the LLM with only the answer text.

methods.name: ingest_document
methods.description: Asynchronously ingests a document, chunks it, embeds chunks, and stores vectors in memory.

methods.name: answer_question
methods.description: Asynchronously answers a question by retrieving relevant document chunks and synthesizing a response.
